svg.title: Hojai is the main hub for regional agar trade
svg.desc: A compact schematic map shows the highlighted locations retained from the previous AATMA trade map. Tirupura and Northeast regional supply flow into Hojai. Separate animated routes leave Hojai for Mumbai and the Middle East. No route connects Mumbai directly to the Middle East. India is labeled at the centroid of its mainland outline. The geography and routes are schematic, not to scale.
svg.text: From Northeast India, through Hojai, to markets
Regional locations retained · route direction shown by moving dashes and arrowheads

g.aria-label: Map of India and western regional context
Every retained regional place is highlighted with a numbered marker

g.text: Keyed to the glowing markers on the map

svg.text: Schematic, not to scale · Geography: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors · Routes: client direction
